summary: Confirmed all 18 requested estimates after reading the complete markdown conversion, including references and appendices, and checking the cited PDF pages directly with pymupdf. All 144 populated numeric fields in stats and participant counts match the appropriate arms, days, and outcomes in PDF p. 4 and Tables 2a, 2b, and 1 (pp. 8, 11-12). The completed laboratory cohort and Table 1 N=61 support the counts. Recognition scores are participant-level maximum-minus-selected-idea rating gaps: construct=other and higher_is=other correctly describe worse recognition at higher values. Task 2 overall_creativity follows the joint novelty-and-usefulness definition in Section 2.3 and the Creativity heading in Table 2b; the conflicting novelty label in Table 1 is already documented. The requested question, measure, unit, timing, AI availability, within-person, comparison, and uncertainty codes are supported. Reported rounding and narrative/table inconsistencies are documented rather than silently corrected. The full-paper outcome inventory revealed no missing eligible outcome or contrast under extraction rules 4-6. No other estimates were numerically reverified.
